PURPOSE: a frozen-transcript player-choice screen. The blind player sees exactly the page that row A showed through scene turn 10 (entry text, scripted-prefix transcript as the real probe renders it, then turns 8, 9, 10), except that the D2 cue text appended to the turn 10 reply differs per arm. Arm `control`: the page unchanged (turn 10 reply ends with `Families of the missing call the broadcast chamber for word.`). Arm `offer`: the same page with that one cue sentence replaced by `Families of the missing call the broadcast chamber for word. Kristin can answer the families with news of the captives.` Assert the cue sentence occurs in the turn 10 reply exactly once and that the two screens differ only by the added sentence. Turn 11 and later are NOT shown.

IMPLEMENT scripts/ringer/stage7/3c_families_offer_probe.py: argparse `--rows` (default bench/results/stage7-3c-escape-close-smoke/rows.json), `--samples` int, `--dry`, `--confirm`, `--out` dir. Reuse the real helpers by import from three_c_probe (do not copy `_ask_player` or `_player_screen`; import via importlib if the module name starts with a digit or sits in scripts). `--dry`: write control.screen.txt, offer.screen.txt, a unified diff (exactly one changed line pair or one added sentence), sha256.json, plan.json (arms, samples, call count = 2 x samples, cap 24 raw_player requests, source row/turn), and make NO call. Live (`--confirm` required, refuse samples > 12 and any total > 24 calls): for each sample index interleave control then offer, one independent player request each through the real `_ask_player` and a SpendBudget with raw_player cap 24 and cloudflare cap 0 (the screen uses player calls only; if SpendBudget cannot express that, add a tiny local counter and say so in notes.md). Append every result (arm, sample, command or error) to rows.json after each call; no retries, no replacement samples, stop nonzero writing run-failure.txt on a budget/quota/child error and keep partial rows. Do not score automatically in live mode.
Also a `--score` mode (free, no calls) that reads rows.json from --out and for each recorded command runs the REAL projected selector in the post-C state with D1 spent (use the helper patterns from tests/test_3c_families_offer.py / tests/test_3c_cue_chain.py `_families_*`) and writes score.json listing, per command, which reveal id (if any) is selected; it must not decide 'answers the families' by itself: that is read by hand.
